You can browse Home and open apps without activation. Setting the default launcher, enabling accessibility, restoring full-screen gestures, personalization, and long-press actions on apps or folders require a license. About remains available. Restore system launcher is available without a license only when MiDuo is already your default home. Enter your purchased code to bind this device online once; after activation, these features work offline.

One code binds to one device, with no expiry. Keep your code: after clearing app data, enter it again online to restore activation on the same device. A factory reset, Android user/profile change or app-signing change may require support. No periodic online checks are required.
Fold animation
On by default. Turn off to disable glass projection on both screens. Screen switching and StandBy are unaffected.
Enable StandBy
Off by default. When enabled, turning the cover screen sideways opens StandBy. The inner screen is unaffected.

Unable to open a browser. Visit https://mymiduo.xyz

Only when you activate, MiDuo sends your authorization code and a one-way, app-scoped device identifier to mymiduo.xyz over HTTPS to bind and restore your license. IMEI, phone number and app list are not collected. The service stores the code hash, binding and activation time; the connection exposes your IP address for security rate limiting.
